rename.from: Use of RestClientBuilder leads to RESTEASY004655 when using OIDC client
rename.to: Use of RestClientBuilder leads to RESTEASY004655

body:
I got it working copying some bits from the resteasy extension:

```java
        SSLContext sslContext = SSLContext.getInstance("SSL");
        sslContext.init(
            null, 
            new TrustManager[] { new PassthroughTrustManager() },
            new SecureRandom());
                
        MyApi api = RestClientBuilder.newBuilder()
            .baseUri(baseUrl)
            .sslContext(sslContext)
            .register(OidcClientRequestFilter.class)
            .register(NoopHostnameVerifier.class)
            .connectTimeout(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            .readTimeout(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            .build(MyApi.class);
```

but I think this should work out of the box as `quarkus.tls.trust-all` is set in the application properties file
Hi @lburgazzoli, indeed, the OIDC client filter itself depends on Vert.x Web Client Mutiny.
@sberyozkin I tested that `OidcClientRequestFilter` is really not the culprit here but it looks like the implementation of `RestClientBuilder` do not honor `quarkus.tls.trust-all`
I will fix it, hopefully today. I have something that should work but one of the tests is failing ATM ;)
Is there a PR that closed this?

https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/18892 

I think I amended `fixes` to the commit after creating the PR and that's why it didn't link
